name: Café Memoria Deux
source:
Cafe Memoria has been open for several months, with great success. It is summer vacation, and Ryne is busy with summer school, along with his friends, Anna, Mikaela, and Jacob. Ryne figures that by taking summer classes, he will have a better chance of going to the college of his choice.

However, Anna, Mikaela, and Jacob are taking remedial classes due to their poor grades; the former two have their work hours cut as a result. Julia, Tristina, and Aurelia are not taking summer classes, but they are still working at Cafe Memoria.

Cafe Memoria is often the hangout spot for Ryne and his friends. One day, Anna gives Ryne a Cafe Memoria summer discount card, for being her friend. He decides to make use of it during his hangouts with his friends before, and after, summer classes.

Cafe Memoria is a place where its slogan is, "Your stay will be memorable." Let's create summer memories at Cafe Memoria!

[Edited from [url=https://pixaelsoft.com/projects/cmd/story.php]the Official website[/url]]
translation:
Cafe Memoria已经开业几个月了，取得了巨大成功。暑假到了，莱恩和他的朋友安娜、米凯拉和雅各布正忙着参加暑期学校。莱恩认为，通过参加暑期课程，他将有更好的机会进入他选择的大学。

然而，安娜、米凯拉和雅各布由于成绩不佳正在参加补习班；前两者的工作时间因此而减少。朱莉娅、特里斯蒂娜和奥里莉亚没有参加暑期课程，但他们仍在纪念咖啡馆工作。

Cafe Memoria经常是Ryne和他的朋友们聚会的地方。有一天，安娜送给莱恩一张Cafe Memoria夏季折扣卡，作为她的朋友。他决定在暑期课程之前和之后与朋友聚会时使用它。

Cafe Memoria的口号是“你的住宿将令人难忘”。让我们在Cafe Memoria创造夏日回忆吧！
